key.name: active-provider
key.summary: Active provider driving the panel icon
key.description: ID of the provider shown in the panel meter: claude, gemini, codex, copilot, opencode.

key.name: enabled-providers
key.summary: List of provider IDs to probe

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.summary: Seconds between automatic quota refreshes (0 = manual only)

key.name: warning-threshold-pct
key.summary: Remaining-quota % below which the meter turns amber

key.name: critical-threshold-pct
key.summary: Remaining-quota % below which the meter turns red

key.name: show-weekly-bar
key.summary: Show the weekly-window hairline below the session bar

key.name: claude-cli-path
key.summary: Path or command name for the Claude CLI binary

key.name: codex-cli-path
key.summary: Path or command name for the Codex CLI binary

key.name: gemini-cli-path
key.summary: Path or command name for the Gemini CLI binary

key.name: gemini-project-id
key.summary: Cached Cloud AI Companion project ID for the Gemini quota API
key.description: Discovered automatically via loadCodeAssist on first fetch; cached here to avoid an extra round-trip on every refresh.

key.name: copilot-cli-path
key.summary: Path or command name for the GitHub Copilot CLI binary

key.name: opencode-cli-path
key.summary: Path or command name for the OpenCode CLI binary

key.name: claude-config-dir
key.summary: Override CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (empty = use env var or ~/.claude)

key.name: cached-quota-json
key.summary: Last-known-good quota data (JSON blob, written by extension)

key.name: request-refresh
key.summary: Toggle to request a quota refresh from the preferences window

key.name: position-area
key.summary: Area of the top panel to show the extension

key.name: position-index
key.summary: Position index in the panel area
key.description: Lower numbers are further left/top, higher numbers are further right/bottom

key.name: show-provider-icon
key.summary: Show the active provider brand icon in the top panel

key.name: panel-label-mode
key.summary: Which percentages to show next to the bar: 0=none 1=session 2=weekly 3=both

key.name: meter-width
key.summary: Width of the panel usage bar in pixels

key.name: stale-timeout-minutes
key.summary: Minutes after which cached quota data is considered stale and the bar dims

key.name: startup-refresh
key.summary: Automatically fetch quota data when the extension loads on login

key.name: opencode-display-mode
key.summary: OpenCode display mode: 'cost' shows local DB spend, 'go-subscription' shows Go plan remaining quota

key.name: opencode-budget-5h
key.summary: Budget in USD for the 5-hour window (0 = show raw cost instead of bar)

key.name: opencode-budget-7d
key.summary: Budget in USD for the 7-day window (0 = show raw cost instead of bar)

key.name: opencode-go-session-quota
key.summary: Total calls in the 5-hour Go subscription window (0 = no bar, show count only)

key.name: opencode-go-weekly-quota
key.summary: Total calls in the weekly Go subscription window (0 = no bar, show count only)

key.name: opencode-go-monthly-quota
key.summary: Total calls in the monthly Go subscription window (0 = no bar, show count only)

key.name: opencode-workspace-id
key.summary: OpenCode workspace ID for Go subscription quota fetching
key.description: Found in the URL when visiting opencode.ai/workspace/{id}/go

key.name: opencode-auth-cookie
key.summary: OpenCode auth cookie for console API access
key.description: Copy the 'auth' cookie value from browser DevTools while logged into opencode.ai

key.name: opencode-go-auto-fetch
key.summary: Automatically fetch Go subscription quotas from console.opencode.ai
key.description: When enabled and credentials are set, fetches real-time usage from the web API instead of relying on manually set quotas
